errors.text_span: steigt erneut bis etwa 1,25 % im Jahr 2015
errors.evidence: The description states the value for Austria in 2015 is approximately 1.25%. The marker and peak in the chart are visibly higher, at approximately 1.30%.

The description incorrectly states that the final data point for Austria (a value of about 1.5%) occurs in the year 2020. The chart shows this steep rise and final point happening after 2020, closer to 2022.
The description claims the line for Germany falls to about -0.25% in 2005. The chart shows the value in 2005 is approximately +0.10%. The line for Germany never reaches -0.25% at any point.

The description incorrectly states that the final data point for Germany (a value of about 1.75%) occurs in the year 2020. The chart shows this steep rise and final point happening after 2020, closer to 2022.
